# BLS 4.0 excerpt

`bls40_excerpt.zip` mirrors the layout of the published `BLS_4_0_2025_DE.zip`
(https://www.blsdb.de/assets/uploads/BLS_4_0_2025_DE.zip, downloaded 2026-10-30):

- `BLS_4_0_2025_DE/BLS_4_0_Daten_2025_DE.xlsx`: the header row (all 418 columns) and 7 food
  rows copied unchanged — F110100 apple, K110132 boiled potato, M111300 whole milk, P253000 red
  wine (trace and below-limit markers), C515100 fortified cornflakes (synthetic folic acid),
  Y361623 pork roast dish (recipe calculation), B121000 wholemeal rye bread (missing value "-").
- `BLS_4_0_2025_DE/BLS_4_0_Components_DE_EN.xlsx`: the published components file, unchanged.

The documentation PDF is not included.

Max Rubner-Institut (2025): Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel (BLS), Version 4.0 – Deutsche
Nährstoffdatenbank. Karlsruhe. DOI: 10.25826/Data20251217-134202-0. Licensed under CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The excerpt is a trimmed copy of the original.
